sentences.l2: 很久以前，人们看书很难。
sentences.l1: A long time ago, it was hard for people to read books.
Because books were handwritten, which was very slow.

sentences.l2: 一个人要写很久才能有一本书。
sentences.l1: One person had to write for a long time before there could be one book.

sentences.l2: 后来，有人发明了印刷术。
印刷术可以很快地印出很多书。
sentences.l1: Printing could print many books very quickly.
Books became more numerous, and also became cheaper.
Many people could now afford books.

sentences.l2: 他们开始学读书和写字。
sentences.l1: They began to learn to read and write.

sentences.l2: 知识慢慢传到很多人那里。
sentences.l1: Knowledge slowly spread to many people.

sentences.l2: 一个德国人改进了印刷机，让印书更快。
sentences.l1: A German improved the printing press, making printing books faster.

sentences.l2: 他用机器印书，一天能印很多本。
sentences.l1: He printed books with a machine and could print many copies in one day.

sentences.l2: 以前一年印不了几本书，现在一天就可以。
sentences.l1: Before, not even a few books could be printed in a year; now it could be done in one day.
Children went to school to learn knowledge.
Books let people know more things.

sentences.l2: 印刷术让知识传播得更快更广。
sentences.l1: Printing made knowledge spread faster and wider.
